items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Elvin Jones as a contemporary drummer and a standard for comparison ('Elvin Jones has got a very nice name, he happens to be one of the good ones'), but does not describe any personal interaction, collaboration, or direct relationship.

ctx.x: Let's just maybe deal a little bit with let's say music that's come about in the last 20 years, such as rock and some of the more recent drummers, say somebody like Elvin Jones or people who have come around after him.
